name: print-social-peach-coral-wellness-instagram-post-template-set
title: Peach and Coral Wellness Post Template Set
whatItIs: A template presentation on chartreuse with one large peach cover post ('Wellness Lifestyle' with a cut-out woman in a red beanie over a lime rounded square) and eight smaller square posts alternating peach, coral and white with food photography and portraits.
whatItMeans: Alternating background colours across posts create a lively grid, and consistent type and small brand marks keep it one family.
techniques: Cut-out person overlapping giant headline letters
Alternating three background colours across the feed
Rounded photo blocks and rounded lime accent shapes
Vertical slider line motif on each post
Star-rating icons and pill CTAs as repeatable details

vocabulary.definition: The large post that introduces a template set.
Cycling background colours across a series.
A person or object placed partly over large type.
